description_en: Lists the security capabilities of normalization rules
description_zh: 获取标准化规则安全能力列表
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem list-normalization-rule-capacities --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --role-for 1733260000000 --normalization-rule-id nr-z0b2ssjteut85uoh9nzp --max-results 50 --next-token AAAAAUqcj6VO4E3ECWIrFczs0000 --normalization-rule-ids nr-z0b2ssjteut85uoh9nzp --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListNormalizationRuleCapacities

parameters.help_en:
The region of the threat analysis Data Management Center. Select the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: Your assets are outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese.

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The user ID that an administrator uses to switch to a member's perspective
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en: The ID of the normalization rule
parameters.name: normalization_rule_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token to start the next query. Leave this parameter empty for the first query. If the response is truncated, use the \`NextToken\` value from the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: A list of normalization rule IDs
parameters.name: normalization_rule_ids
